metadata.scenario: A new customer calls regarding an unexpected increase in their monthly subscription fee without prior notice. They insist on an explanation. Category: Billing. Flags: billing_dispute.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, this is Helen Johnson. I’m calling about an unexpected increase in my monthly subscription fee. I’m sorry to hear that, Helen. Can you tell me more about the increase? Yes, I noticed an increase on my latest bill and I wasn’t informed about any changes. It seems unfair. I completely understand your concern. Let me check your account details. One moment, please. Sure, take your time. I’ve been with you for months now, and I appreciate the physical therapy service. Thank you for your patience, Helen. I see here that there was a change in our pricing structure for some services recently. I see, but why wasn’t I notified about this? I feel like I should have received an email or a call. I understand why you feel that way. We usually send out notifications, but it seems there may have been an oversight. That’s really frustrating. I rely on these services, and unexpected fees can really add up. I totally get that, and I apologize for any inconvenience caused. Let's review your current services. Yes, please. I’m especially concerned about my physical therapy sessions. You have been receiving physical therapy regularly for your shoulder recovery. The new rate is $110-$140 per session. That’s significantly higher than before! I need to know if there are options available. I understand, Helen. We do have options for package deals if you’d like to discuss those. Yes, I’d like to hear about those packages. Can they help reduce the cost? Absolutely! We offer a discounted rate for purchasing multiple sessions upfront. I can provide you with those details. That sounds helpful. Also, can you check on why I didn’t receive any notification regarding the fee increase? Yes, I’ll follow up on that. We want to ensure our communication is clear and timely. Great, thank you. I just want to make sure I’m not surprised by charges in the future. I completely understand. I’ll make a note to follow up with you within the week on both the billing and the package options. Sounds good, Margaret. Thank you for your help today. You're very welcome, Helen. Thank you for your understanding, and have a wonderful day! You too, bye. Goodbye!
